title: 2026 Bank of America Chicago Marathon Participant Guide (Chinese Simplified, official PDF)
claims: The 2026 event is the 48th running, held on Sunday 11 October 2026, starting and finishing in Grant Park over 26.2 miles through 29 neighbourhoods.

There are 20 aid stations approximately one to two miles apart, each with a medical tent and runner transport, standard and ADA toilets, Gatorade Endurance Formula, a public-address announcer and water.
Maurten Gel 100 is available near station 9 at 12.4 miles and station 14 at 18.1 miles, with 25 g of carbohydrate per sachet.
Bananas are offered at stations 16 to 18, between 20.2 and 23 miles.
Culligan water refill points are before stations 4, 7, 12 and 16, at 5.7, 10.1, 15.7 and 20.3 miles.
A Biofreeze Pain Relief Zone is at 21.2 miles at Cermak Road and Archer Avenue.
The course time limit is 6 hours 30 minutes, or a 15-minute-per-mile pace, and runner transport vehicles cover all 20 aid stations.
The Event Alert System uses green, yellow, red and black levels, communicated by email, the website, expo public address and colour-coded flags at the start, finish and all 20 aid stations.
The guide recommends CTA, Metra, the South Shore Line, Divvy, free bike valet and Millennium Garages, and discourages driving.

Race-day starts are 7:20 a.m. for the men's professional wheelchair, 7:21 for the women's professional wheelchair, 7:23 for handcycle, 7:30 for professional men and women, 7:32 for the elite start, 7:35 for Wave 1, 8:00 for Wave 2 and 8:35 for Wave 3.
Grant Park opens to runners at 5:30 a.m. and to spectators at 9:30 a.m.

The event rules prohibit unregistered wheeled devices, baby joggers, strollers, skateboards, bicycles, motorised devices, selfie sticks, camera mounts, drones and hydration-bladder packs or running vests, while allowing front-pocket running vests, fuel belts, handheld bottles and soft flasks.
